ActorTalk: During that incident, I fought alongside several other students to hold off the enemy...
But halfway through, my own lack of ability left a gap in our tactics.
In the end... someone died because of this.
This is all my fault. Everyone was doing so well—I thought everything would go smoothly too.
...Afterwards, I was punished and reprimanded. Everyone says it's okay to move on now, but I still can't let it go.
Gray Raven Commandant, what do you think I should do?
You've got to figure it out.
You're right... I have to bear the consequences.
That's true... no use crying over spilled milk. What's done is done.
So all I can do from now on is remember this mistake and make sure it never happens again.
